program.name: HIIT Long Burn
program.subject: HIIT
program.blurb: Long no-gear HIIT: a circuit and Tabatas one day, an EMOM and an AMRAP the next.
program.about: A long HIIT session with no equipment. One day is a circuit of jumps, pushes and legs, then Tabatas, twenty seconds hard and ten seconds rest; the other is an EMOM then an AMRAP of the same kind of moves. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
